{{DISPLAYTITLE:WoW Voiceover}}

WoW-Voiceover adds voice-overs to npc's. no custom-made Turtle content is currently voiced!

== How to install ==
Download the '''[https://github.com/mrthinger/wow-voiceover/releases/download/v1.4.3/AI_VoiceOver-WoW_1.12-v1.4.3.zip 1.12 Add-on]''' and '''[https://github.com/mrthinger/wow-voiceover/releases/download/v1.3.1/AI_VoiceOverData_Vanilla-v1.0.0.zip Vanilla Sounds]''' zips and extract them to your Add-ons folder.

== '''Important''' ==
You must use the [[Addons#Installing%20Addons%20by%20Hand|manual install method]]!

== Git links ==
[https://github.com/mrthinger/wow-voiceover/releases/ '''(mrthinger)''']

== Contribute ==
Contribute voices on [https://allvoice.ai/ allvoice.ai] so I can give each NPC a unique AI voice-model to power their dialog. The top rated voice for each NPC will be used.
